newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Borough of Alpha, N.J.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Borough of Alpha, N.J.

text.p: Sealed proposals will be received by the Hon. Arthur D. Merrill, Chief Financial Officer, Borough of Alpha, County of Warren, New Jersey, at his office, located in the

Municipal Building, 1001 East Boulevard, Alpha, New Jersey 08865 at 11:00 a.m. on October 22, 1996 subject to the provisions of the Official Notice of Sale dated October 10, 1996 (the Notice of Sale'').
Time: bids to be received by 11:00 a.m. award shall be
by the Chief Financial Officer prior to 11:00 p.m. on said date.
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
The Bonds are subject to redemption prior to maturity as set forth in the Bond Resolution and Notice of Sale.
Denominations:$5,000 each or any integral multiple

thereof, as may be necessary to comply with the proposal of the successful bidder of the Bonds to accept less than the full amount of the Bonds offered officially for public sale in accordance with the Notice of Sale.

Interest Rates: The Bonds will bear interest at the rate specified by the successful bidder determined, in accordance with the Notice of Sale. Each proposal must specify a single rate of interest per annum that the Bonds are to bear, in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%.
Legal Opinion: Frohling, Hudak, & McCarthy, P.C.
Pursuant to Rule 15c2-12 promulgated under the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, a Preliminary Official Statement has been prepared and may be obtained from the Borough.

In order to assist the bidders in complying with Rule 15c2-12 (b) (5), the Borough will undertake, pursuant to the Resolution and a continuing Disclosure Certificate, to provide annual reports and notices of certain events. A description of this undertaking is set forth in the
Copies of the Proposal for Bonds, the Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and additional information on

the Bond Sale may be obtained from the Hon. Arthu Merrill, Chief Financial Officer, Borough of Alpha, 1001 East Boulevard, Alpha, New Jersey 08865, (908) 454-0088, John G. Hudak, Esq., Frohling, Hudak & McCarthy, P.C., 425 Eagle Rock Avenue, Roseland, New Jersey 07068, (201) 226- 4600, or Earl Snook, R.M.A., Ferraioli, Cerullo & Cuva, 100BMain Street, Newton, New Jersey 07860, (201) 579-3212.
By order of the Borough Council, Borough of Alpha.
